select m.id, m.user_id, COALESCE(m.match_status, '0') as match_status, m.create_time, m.update_time, si.student_id, si.in_school, si.school_year, si.student_profile_number, si.adid, si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name, si.dsej_student_id from ${studentProfilesDatabase}.student_info si left join sys_student_match m on m.student_id collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci = si.student_id where si.student_id is not null and m.id is null
